Steve, you mentioned you wanted to see that new Janet Carman film.
Hmm.
Well, some of us in the department are going to see it tonight.
That sounds great, but I probably won't leave work until around 7.
What time are you going?
We were planning on going at 6.
30.
Sure you can't come to that?
Yeah, I haven't finished this month's sales report yet.
Are there any later showings?
Well, there is another one at 9 o'clock, but I don't know if the others want to go that late.
I'll talk to them and let you know.

听起来不错，但我可能得等到大约7点才离开工作。
你们什么时候去？
我们计划6点去。
30。
你肯定不能来吗？
是的，我还没完成这个月的销售报告。
还有其他场次吗？
嗯，9点钟还有一个，但我不知道其他人是否想去那么晚。
我会和他们谈谈，然后告诉你。
